page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating without hyperthreading at one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For hardware acceleration, the server includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge offers an entry-level GPU-accelerated hardware profile, balancing dedicated CPU resources with a lower-tier accelerator. This makes it suitable for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand high-end tensor-core performance. Appropriate workloads include video transcoding, low-latency inference, entry-level machine learning, and general-purpose tasks that benefit from hardware-accelerated graphics or compute.
